but not by hand
one may dissolve it by hand

she: for your master I made it and he ate -- and you do not eat?
Rava bar Shaba: I was standing before Ravina, and they stirred it for him with a garlic core, and he ate
Mar Zutra: the halakha is not as any of these teachings
but as this one that was stated
and he may put honey into it
and he may not beat it, but [only] mix
cress ground on Shabbat eve: on the morrow he may put oil and vinegar into it
and he may draw amita into it
and he may not beat [the cress], but [only] mix
garlic crushed on Shabbat eve: on the morrow he may put beans and grits into it
and he may not pound [the garlic], but [only] mix
and he may draw amita into it
what is amita? mint (ninya)
Abaye: learn from this that mint is good for cress
